author: (Longley, 1927)

note.en: A 4 cm tube blenny that lives in holes in coral rock and is brooded by the male; here known only from one 1972 museum specimen at Puerto Vargas, Cahuita (depth range approximate).
note.es: Un blenio tubícola de 4 cm que vive en huecos de roca coralina; aquí solo se conoce un espécimen de museo de 1972 en Puerto Vargas, Cahuita (rango de profundidad aproximado).

evidence: OBIS: 1 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)

sources.t: OBIS and GBIF museum records (UCR Zoology Museum, LACM) from Limón, Isla Uvita, Cahuita and Puerto Viejo

marks.en: Tiny blenny with a spiny head peeking out of a hole in rock.
marks.es: Blenio diminuto con cabeza espinosa que asoma de un agujero en la roca.
